meta.parties: Rustomjee Et Al v. Khan Et Al

rules.statement: The procedure adopted by the parties on the petitioner's application was summary procedure under chapter XXIV of the Code, which was in order by reason of the provisions of section 595.
rules.supporting_quote: "The procedure adopted by the parties on the petitioner's application was summary procedure under chapter XXIV. of the Code, That, I think. was in order by reason of the provisions of section 595."
